callable.signature: Falah.Domain.Payroll.PayrollRules.OutstandingAdvance(IEnumerable<(string Type, Money Debit, Money AdvanceDeduction)> entries, long floorAtZero)

classification: SUBSTANTIVE_REVIEW_VERIFIED for source semantics and current call reachability; no active production effect or new defect established

production_caller_search.interpretation: definition only; no application call site found

verified_behavior: The helper takes synthetic tuples, adds Debit for exact lowercase Type advance, subtracts AdvanceDeduction for exact lowercase payroll_settlement, sums, then clamps to caller-provided floorAtZero (default zero). Other casing/types contribute zero.

Application persisted employee ledger uses Type strings based on nameof(LedgerEntryType.X), including PascalCase Advance and PayrollSettlement. EmployeeLedgerEntryEntity has no separate AdvanceDeduction property.

Current CreatePayrollHandler maps period ledger facts to CalculatePayrollLines; comments and assignments keep RequestedAdvanceDeduction/AvailableAdvance at zero. PayPayrollHandler posts settlement as PayrollSettlement debit for net payable and does not persist a separate advance-deduction field.

Therefore the helper has no current production caller; passing the raw persisted ledger shape would not satisfy its string/tuple contract. Its present status is an unwired future interface/legacy port, not a demonstrated current balance or payroll miscalculation.
A custom positive/negative floor changes the clamp; no caller or policy for nonzero floor exists.

tests_review.domain: PayrollRulesTests.cs:85-104 exercises only synthetic lowercase tuple values and default zero floor; no persisted-type adapter, caller wiring or custom floor test.

disposition.reason: No production caller, no observed output affecting payroll or employee balance, and no confirmed requirement that this legacy helper be wired. Do not report as current defect.
disposition.future_action: If a future change wires it, define an explicit mapper from persisted ledger types and a source for AdvanceDeduction, specify floorAtZero policy, then test PascalCase/legacy variants, missing/unrecognized categories, empty input and settlement lifecycle.
